name: Agent Velocity
mission: Kymata Labs makes open-source AI tools, models and infrastructure easier to understand through focused, source-backed indexes. We publish dated source signals, explain ranking methods and limitations, and separate advertising from ranking and inclusion.
scope: Explore coding-agent projects and their public repository signals.

snapshot.coverage: focused source selection; not an exhaustive census of the ecosystem

capabilities.description: Browse dated catalog records and published detail pages
Search the catalog locally in the browser; raw search text is not sent by these controls.
Use the available catalog category filters and sorting controls
Read source references, snapshot dates, methodology, selection guidance and evidence limits.

limitations: Snapshot signals are not proof of quality, safety, license suitability or fitness for a project. Verify upstream sources before adoption.
Search and filters are browser controls; this description does not advertise a remote search API or an MCP endpoint.
Crawl permission and machine-readable descriptions do not guarantee crawling, indexing, ranking or AI citation.

measurement.search_input: browser-local; no raw search strings in the staged analytics design
measurement.ga4_status: not verified or enabled by this discovery manifest

policy: robots.txt is the crawl policy. ai.txt, llms.txt and this custom capabilities document are descriptive guidance, not access controls.
